patterns.service_pattern: Services are created as classes in core/ directory and registered in container.ts
patterns.middleware_pattern: Middleware is added via app.addHook('onRequest', ...) in fastify.adapter.ts
patterns.error_pattern: All errors follow RFC 7807 Problem Details format via serializeError()
patterns.test_pattern: Tests use Vitest with createTestApp() helper and follow AAA (Arrange-Act-Assert) pattern
patterns.dependency_pattern: Dependencies are managed via pnpm workspaces, added to package.json

existing_implementations.description: Found existing audit service pattern in apps/api/src/core/audit/audit.service.ts that shows how to create core services

security_context.current_vulnerability: Mock JWT tokens use simple Base64 encoding without cryptographic signatures, allowing token forgery
security_context.current_verification: None - userId and tenantId are extracted from headers without token verification
